threshold.rationale: The observed distribution has 18 candidates at >=4 top-level genres, then drops to 3 at >=6 and stays at 3 through >=10 before dropping to 2 at >=12. The first stable elbow is therefore 6. This threshold was chosen from the distribution shape, not to admit any desired word.

admissionRule: Reject any term if using it for a product whose input does not contain that term could assert or imply that product's performance, specification, quality, capability, material, size, capacity, compatibility, or feature.
note: Layer 2 remains empty until the one-time candidate-list review is completed. No term may be hand-added.
